connectorMetaData.name: DICOM C-FIND SCP
connectorMetaData.author: NextGen Healthcare
connectorMetaData.description: Listens for DICOM C-FIND requests from remote SCUs. Each incoming query is dispatched to the channel as XML; the channel's response is streamed back as C-FIND-RSP PENDING items. Supports Study Root, Patient Root, and Modality Worklist information models.
